6993005a769ba1a3e4e4: The IDF announces: in 2027 every reservist will be recruited for up to 58 days a year; Accordingly - the Chief of Staff decided to reduce the size of the fighting forces in all sectors: "If we continue like this, we will destroy the reserve system and the fitness for war" all the details >> In a significant announcement by the IDF, the army announces its intention to reduce the size of the fighting forces in all the theaters of combat - in Lebanon, Gaza, Yusuf and Syria, with the aim of slightly easing the burden on the reserve officers during the coming year. The decisions made by the Chief of Staff: 1. The number of reserve days per year for each reserve soldier decreased from 90 days (on average) in recent years, to up to 58 days gross, of which 42 days are operational mission days. 2. The format of service in the reserves will change from a one-week model, to a format of two-thirds in combat, one-third at home. 3. In accordance with the reduction of reserve days, it was decided that the scope of the fighting forces in the combat sectors would be reduced. This is about reducing the number of battalions in all sectors. The battalions will be reduced from Gaza, Lebanon, Syria and Israel. A senior officer says: If today we are in the reality of double 4 forces in the combat sectors compared to October 2023, we will go down to a situation of double 3. 4. In addition to reducing the reserves in the sectors, the scope of the regular brigades in combat will also be reduced: two regular brigades will be in training (in rounds) - one in the northern sector and one in the southern sector, as a reserve force for each sector. In 2027, each regular division will have two months of training, plus about a month of refresher. The IDF explains the move: "If we continue like this in the current reality - we will destroy our reserve system and destroy our fitness and readiness for war. We have no choice - we are required to do the same tasks, with fewer people. It is possible that in the future, if there are changes in the security situation and the assessment of the situation, it will be necessary to change the situation again - but right now that is the desire.' The reasons presented by the army for the decision: - The training in the IDF did not take place as required in the last 3 years
